modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 5, 2024: The Boeing Starliner is launched on its first crewed flight, carrying astronauts Barry Wilmore and Sunita Williams to the International Space Station.
On June 5, 1975: The United Kingdom holds its first country-wide referendum on membership of the European Economic Community (EEC).
On June 5, 1949: Thailand elects Orapin Chaiyakan, the first female member of Thailand's Parliament.
June 5 is observed as Constitution Day (Denmark).
June 5 is observed as Arbor Day (New Zealand).
